prospective_diagnostic_limits.origin: Engineering preparation limits, not industry standards or retroactive scoring
prospective_diagnostic_limits.caster_rule: Report loaded/unloaded/mixed support and circular angle differences; never force an unloaded caster to meet rolling-speed equality
prospective_diagnostic_limits.enforcement: Analysis flags only so far; online reset gate not implemented, no caster teleport, no extra reset attempts

outcomes.legacy: Keep native/whole-route/crossing(first+50ms to plane+0.5m), physical arrivals and2sstop unchanged
new: all contact identities and sampled loads
all retriggers and command/body recovery sustained0.3s, minimum forward progress, failures
outcomes.negative_control: First50ms GT slip only if all GT/joint quadrature support precedes first actual intervention; missing IMU stays missing
outcomes.failure_rule: Retain every attempt, including approach flags/failures/censoring; never success-only averages or zero-imputation

stop_and_decision.stop_on: reporting/provenance/physical failure; no retry or replacement
stop_and_decision.stage_A_result: Four PI runs estimate a coarse repeatability range only; no confidence/power claim from n=2 perseed
stop_and_decision.balance_failed: Stop intervention planning; one supported setup correction at most, no new speed parameter
stop_and_decision.balance_passed: Report raw PI-PI differences across metrics, including contact order and negative control; specify smallest worthwhile effect/application cost and comparison budget BEFORE any intervention
stop_and_decision.unresolved_noise: If noise cannot be separated from effect within a justified affordable budget, stop predictive-governor H2 branch; no endless repeats
stop_and_decision.stage_B: No new candidate or run count selected now; separate predeclared randomized blocked experiment only after StageA review
stop_and_decision.gate_time_tracking: Existing limits unchanged: mean time<=18.5s and<=1.05xPI, mean physical RMSE<=1.05xPI
